title: macleania rupestris
intro: Macleania rupestris, commonly known as the alpine macleania, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Ericaceae. It is native to New South Wales in Australia. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Macleania rupestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
